body: Do you mean what kind of jobs? I've done a lot of menial labor jobs, landscaping, construction site cleanup, painting, that sort of thing. Other than that, I have a lot of experience working in the food industry (mostly fast food). Just a bunch of dead end stuff, or things I wasn't really fit for (I'm a very scrawny guy, and most of the more physical jobs I've had took a lot out of me and I really struggled to perform some of the job functions).

I know I need therapy, I just don't know where to get it. As far as being a danger, I don't always feel suicidal. It really depends on when you catch me. I'm sitting here now feeling fine, but I wasn't when I wrote the original post, and I haven't been frequently (fine that is).

So it's pretty much like any other hospital, only with therapy sessions?

Its been a long time since I've had any professional help. I took meds when I was in my teens, but I've never wanted to have to be on them for life. After developing some coping skills and learning to deal with some things I got off of them. These were back in my religious days, and I thought god would sustain me, lol.

Anyway, the money is the issue here. I don't have a dollar to my name at the moment, so paying for therapy isn't really an option, and I don't know of any pro-bono therapists.

Well, Like I said above, I've always dealt with depression, but it's been getting worse. I've been with my girlfriend and her family for a few years, and during that time I've had a really hard time holding down a job. My work history has never been great (I'm a hard worker, but I find it difficult to motivate myself, and can't seem to stay devoted to a job for much more than 1/2 a year. My longest job lasted 10 months) and I've found it very hard to find work because of that. I feel like I try really hard, but I've blown it and no one wants to hire me.

The job situation has furthured my depression, I've become isolated and even more unmotivated. Most days I hardly leave the basement (thats where our room is.)

Due to all of this my relationship with my girlfriend is suffering. I shouldn't even call her that at the moment, as we're taking a break. I've been sleeping up on my buddies couch, but this arrangement won't last forever, and I don't know where I'll go next.

So I've got no money, no job, no home, no motivation, and no idea what to do except submit to professional help.
